text:
sofia_support: Hey team — customer on O2 UK reports our SSE stream closes mid-response when the phone enters roaming (moves from home network -> roaming). They get a partial JSON payload and then an early EOF. Happening across Android WebView and native app. Customer says it started after last week’s infra change. CC @alex_oncall :eyes:

ivan_roaming: Seen similar before with NAT timeouts while carrier swaps. Quick ask: any recent changes to nginx or proxy timeouts? Also any auth token TTLs that might cut mid-stream?

deploy-bot: recent deploy 1769670000 — updated ingress nginx: keepalive_timeout from 75s -> 30s in config-routable. No canary, rolled to prod cluster-a yesterday.

sofia_support: ah that matches their timeline. They reported disconnects ~30s after stream start. Customer logs: "HTTP/1.1 200 OK" then some chunks, then connection reset. They attached a small dump: 
```
chunk: {"id": "abc123", "text": "partial..."}\nerror: socket hang up
```

alex_oncall: 1) nginx keepalive change likely candidate. 2) roaming triggers carrier NAT and TCP reestablish; if keepalive is shorter than the carrier's expected session life, middlebox can drop. 3) Also check whether we send any periodic SSE comment/heartbeat to keep the connection alive.

qa_erin: Repro steps I used on Android: 1) Start EventSource to our endpoint in a simple webview test app. 2) Start on home WiFi / 4G, stream for ~10s then flip to roaming by enabling "Data roaming" and forcing carrier profile via SIM profile toggle. Observed partial chunk then connection close at ~28-35s. Console snippet: 
```
EventSource onmessage: {"chunk":"..."}
EventSource onerror: Event { type: 'error' }
```

ivan_roaming: Can we get the raw response headers for a failing request? Need to see Transfer-Encoding, Connection, and any server-side Content-Length (should be absent). Also want to confirm we use chunked transfer and occasional colon-heartbeat comments like `: ping` every 15s.

sofia_support: Customer attached headers: 
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/event-stream
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
Cache-Control: no-cache
Connection: keep-alive
X-Request-Id: req-789

```
But no periodic comments from our side in their trace.

alex_oncall: Two immediate mitigations: A) re-enable longer keepalive (set nginx keepalive_timeout >= 90s) and ensure kernel TCP keepalive probes are enabled on our upstreams. B) add SSE server-side comment heartbeat `: keepalive\n\n` every 15s. That helps carriers/NATs not consider the connection idle.

qa_erin: I can add a quick build to include server-heartbeat toggle in the staging binary for repro. Suggest flag `--sse-heartbeat-interval=15s`.

ivan_roaming: Also instrument client reconnection behavior: EventSource will auto-reconnect but some in-app clients (custom fetch/streams) don't. Customer uses a hybrid SDK that swallows onerror and doesn't retry. Could be app bug. 

sofia_support: Customer says they use our JS SDK v1.2.3 in a React Native WebView. They saw a reconnect attempt but it aborted with auth 401 on reconnect. Maybe short lived token TTL.

alex_oncall: If reconnect fails with 401 on short TTL we should 1) check token refresh window and 2) ensure our reconnect logic exchanges a fresh token before re-establishing. In the short term, extend token TTL for streams by a margin (e.g., add 60s grace) or use separate stream token.

deploy-bot: Can roll nginx keepalive rollback to 75s if needed. Patch for heartbeat and token-grace require release.

sofia_support: Next steps agreed: 1) Rollback/nginx config change to 75s on prod cluster-a (deploy team) — alex? 2) QA will put heartbeat toggle into staging and run roaming repro — erin. 3) Support to ask customer for PCAP or long curl trace and confirm client SDK version and whether reconnect attempted. 4) Engineering to investigate token TTL for stream reauth.

alex_oncall: I'll take nginx rollback and check upstream kernel keepalive settings. Also will add temporary SSE comment heartbeat via ingress LUA if we can patch without full release.

qa_erin: ETA: staging heartbeat build in 2 business days. I'll attach test matrix and logs when ready.

sofia_support: I'll message the customer asking for a curl trace and whether they can test after we rollback. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
